summary: One-frame batch of answers delivered by ls::ugc::ModDependencyCachedRequestSystem (macOS Update writes it) to the GUI (registry total 112, client only): a HashMap<ModItemDependenciesInfoId, response> at +0 and a HashSet at +0x40.

fields.name: ModId
fields.evidence: ls::ugc::ModItemDependenciesInfoID, 16 bytes (Windows key stride 0x10 in bg3.exe+0x3BE3780 / bg3.exe+0x3BE4ED0); macOS HashTable<ModItemDependenciesInfoID>::Ensure (bg3_macos_x64+0x2B60DB0) hashes the qword at +0 and compares it first; RequestItemDependencies(unsigned long long, bool) names it as the mod id.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: macOS Ensure compares one byte at +8 (the bool argument of RequestItemDependencies). Windows bg3.exe+0x3BE4ED0 hashes and compares the key with the generic 16-byte ops (k[0] ^ k[1], FUN_1405CA2A0), which reads +8 as a whole qword: the byte width rests on macOS.

fields.name: _Pad9
fields.evidence: padding (compared as part of a qword by the Windows 16-byte key ops)

fields.name: HashKeys
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x3BE5B80 (AllocRaw 0x70) zeroes a HashMap (+0..+0x3F) and a HashSet (+0x40..+0x6F); destructor bg3.exe+0x3B79D10 destroys the map at +0 - bucket array of ls::HashSet

fields.name: Keys
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x3BE5B80 (AllocRaw 0x70) zeroes a HashMap (+0..+0x3F) and a HashSet (+0x40..+0x6F); destructor bg3.exe+0x3B79D10 destroys the map at +0 - keys (written out member by member because the key is a struct)

fields.name: Values
fields.evidence: Value storage at +0x30 (values: ls::ugc::ModItemDependenciesInfoResponse, stride 0x20 - FUN_143b7d760 frees an array (element 0x50, net::UGCModDependency) at value+8 for each key).

fields.name: ValuesCapacity
fields.evidence: size of the value storage (ls::HashMap values are an uninitialised static array: pointer + count)

fields.name: SetHashKeys
fields.evidence: Destructor bg3.exe+0x3B79D10 runs the plain-key HashSet destructor bg3.exe+0x582AD0 on +0x40; macOS component destructor calls HashTable<ls::ugc::ModItemDependenciesInfoID>::~HashTable(this+0x40) - bucket array of ls::HashSet

fields.name: SetKeys
fields.evidence: Destructor bg3.exe+0x3B79D10 runs the plain-key HashSet destructor bg3.exe+0x582AD0 on +0x40; key type assumed equal to the map's key (not checked) - keys (written out member by member because the key is a struct)

open_questions: Width of ModItemDependenciesInfoID +8: a byte on macOS, compared as part of a qword by the Windows 16-byte key ops.

The map's value storage is written as raw parts (pointer + count); value strides are known from the Windows destructors (see the Values row), the value structs are not declared. (ls::ugc::ModItemDependenciesInfoResponse, 0x20 bytes, with an Array of 0x50-byte net::UGCModDependency at +8)
status_reason: no live or captured instance: needs a situation that creates it
second_pass: macOS component destructor confirms both containers are keyed by ModItemDependenciesInfoID; the key is 16 bytes on Windows, but the width of its second member is known from macOS only.
